decks.notes: This deck focuses on controlling the game through card advantage and disruption. It uses cards like Narset, Parter of Veils and Teferi, Time Raveler to limit the opponent's options while generating value for itself. The deck also utilizes powerful removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and Prismatic Ending to deal with threats efficiently. It aims to outvalue the opponent with cards like Hullbreacher and Shark Typhoon, while also having access to counter spells like Force of Will and Force of Negation for further disruption.

This deck focuses on quickly playing out powerful creatures and disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Chalice of the Void and Elite Spellbinder. The goal is to apply pressure early on with aggressive creatures like Archon of Emeria and Solitude, while also using cards like Seasoned Dungeoneer and Anointed Peacekeeper to control the board. The deck aims to establish board dominance and push for a quick victory by leveraging its proactive creatures and disruptive elements.

The deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana with creatures like Nettle Sentinel and Heritage Druid, then using Natural Order to search for powerful finishers like Craterhoof Behemoth. Glimpse of Nature allows for explosive card draw, while cards like Quirion Ranger and Wirewood Symbiote help maintain card advantage and tempo. The deck aims to swarm the board with elves, generating large amounts of mana with Gaea's Cradle and overwhelming the opponent with a big, game-ending attack. The presence of cards like Allosaurus Shepherd and Boseiju, Who Endures helps protect the combo from disruption.

This Elves combo deck aims to generate a massive amount of mana using cards like Gaea's Cradle and Heritage Druid, while also drawing tons of cards with Glimpse of Nature. The deck can quickly ramp up to play powerful threats like Craterhoof Behemoth and Atraxa, Grand Unifier, and can search for key combo pieces with Green Sun's Zenith. Additionally, the deck includes disruptive elements like Collector Ouphe and Endurance to disrupt opponents' strategies. Overall, the deck focuses on quickly assembling a powerful board presence and overwhelming the opponent with its synergistic combo potential.

This deck focuses on quickly tempoing out your opponent with aggressive creatures like Dragon's Rage Channeler and Murktide Regent, while disrupting their game plan with counterspells like Force of Will and Daze. By using cantrips like Brainstorm and Ponder to filter through your deck, you can maintain card advantage and find the right answers at the right time. Wasteland is used to disrupt your opponent's mana base, while Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat provide additional removal and reach. Overall, this deck aims to apply pressure while keeping control of the game.

This deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan while applying pressure with aggressive creatures. It aims to control the board with cards like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Spirit of the Labyrinth, while using disruptive elements like Wasteland and Karakas to slow down the opponent. Utilizing Aether Vial to cheat creatures into play and powerful equipment like Umezawa's Jitte and Batterskull to enhance their creatures, the deck aims to establish a strong board presence and overwhelm the opponent. Additionally, the inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion provides additional value and flexibility throughout the game.

The main idea of this deck is to quickly and efficiently play multiple artifacts to create a powerful board presence while disrupting the opponent's strategy with cards like Chalice of the Void and Force of Will. Emphasis is placed on generating card advantage through cards like Urza's Bauble and Thoughtcast, while also utilizing powerful artifact creatures like Sai, Master Thopterist and Otawara, Soaring City to pressure the opponent. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggression and control through the use of artifact synergy and tempo plays.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly assemble a board state with powerful artifact creatures and artifacts while utilizing cost reduction effects like Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Sai, Master Thopterist. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan with cards like Chalice of the Void and Force of Will while generating card advantage with cards like Urza's Bauble and Thoughtcast. Urza's Saga is used to tutor for key artifacts that can further strengthen the board state. Overall, the deck focuses on aggressive plays and utilizing artifacts synergies to overwhelm the opponent.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly assemble the combo pieces of Cephalid Illusionist, Nomads en-Kor, and Shuko to mill your entire library, getting Narcomoeba and Thassa's Oracle into play. With Narcomoeba triggering when milled and Oracle providing a win condition, the deck aims to win the game in a single, explosive turn. The deck also includes disruption in the form of Force of Will, Cabal Therapy, and Teferi, Time Raveler, as well as additional combo pieces like Stoneforge Mystic and Kaldra Compleat. The use of Urza's Saga provides additional access to combo pieces and threats.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize small, efficient creatures like Delver of Secrets and Tarmogoyf alongside powerful instant spells like Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning to quickly deal damage to the opponent. The deck also aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan by using countermagic like Force of Will and Daze, as well as land destruction with Wasteland. The inclusion of cards like Mishra's Bauble and Murktide Regent allows for card advantage and late-game threats, while cards like Brainstorm and Ponder help with card selection and deck manipulation.

The deck focuses on controlling the opponent's actions through counterspells, removal spells, and disruptive creatures. It utilizes cards like Force of Will and Swords to Plowshares to answer threats while also generating card advantage with cards like Brainstorm and Sylvan Library. The deck also incorporates utility lands like Wasteland and Mystic Sanctuary to further disrupt the opponent's game plan. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue the opponent and dictate the pace of the game through efficient resource management and strategic decision-making.

The deck focuses on assembling the combo of Puresteel Paladin, Colossus Hammer, and Sigarda's Aid to create a powerful board presence and win the game quickly. The Stoneforge Mystic package helps to search for the necessary pieces, while cards like Swords to Plowshares and Mana Tithe provide protection and disruption against opponent's threats. The deck also includes utility lands like Karakas and Wasteland to deal with opposing creatures and lands. Overall, the strategy revolves around equipping Puresteel Paladin with Colossus Hammer to deal massive amounts of damage in a short amount of time.

The main concept of this deck is to use the combo of Painter's Servant and Grindstone to mill your opponent's deck. The deck also includes cards like Goblin Welder and Urza's Saga to help assemble the combo quickly. Red Elemental Blast and Pyroblast are included to protect your combo pieces from removal spells, while cards like Simian Spirit Guide and Lotus Petal allow for fast mana acceleration. Overall, this deck aims to disrupt your opponent's game plan and win quickly with the Painter combo.

The deck focuses on utilizing artifacts to generate card advantage and tempo while disrupting opponents with cards like Chalice of the Void and Force of Will. By combining powerful artifact cards like Urza's Saga and Emry, Lurker of the Loch, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a fast and efficient aggressive strategy. The inclusion of cards like Sai, Master Thopterist and Thought Monitor further enhances the artifact synergy, creating a versatile and effective aggro archetype that can quickly take control of the game.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly assemble the combo of Dark Depths and Thespian's Stage to create a 20/20 indestructible Marit Lage token. The deck includes cards like Crop Rotation and Green Sun's Zenith to help find the combo pieces, while also utilizing ramp and removal spells to control the board. Cards like Knight of the Reliquary and Elvish Reclaimer provide additional ways to search for lands needed for the combo. The deck aims to win the game quickly and efficiently by utilizing the powerful Dark Depths combo.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly establish board presence and disrupt the opponent's game plan by utilizing aggressive creatures like Archon of Emeria, Fury, and Solitude. The deck aims to take control of the game early on through powerful cards like Chalice of the Void and Trinisphere, while also utilizing cards like Cavern of Souls to ensure its creatures can't be countered. The inclusion of Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Seasoned Dungeoneer allow for card advantage and additional pressure on the opponent. Overall, the deck focuses on fast, proactive plays to overwhelm the opponent and secure a victory.
